content.what_it_is: Python (numpy/matplotlib) frame renderer for the FUNWAVE-TVD levee_1d solitary case. Sets simulationDir='../work_solitary' with output and plots subdirectories (L7-L9), creating plots/ if absent (L12-L13). Loads depth_levee.txt negated so depth is negative under MWL (L16, comment on line), gets [Nglob,Mglob] from shape with a comment that Fortran/FUNWAVE index order is reversed vs C/Python (L17). Parameters: numOfETA=15 files (L20), Lt=40.0 m domain length (L21), WaveMaker=4.0 m location (L22), plotInt=30.0 s (L23). Function readETAData(num,numOfETA,postprocessDir) (L25-L37) asserts the index range (L29), builds outputDir/eta_{0:05d} (L33), prints progress (L34) and returns np.loadtxt (L35). Loop i=1..numOfETA (L40-L72): reads eta (L41), x=np.linspace(0,Lt,Mglob) (L42), 18x4 inch dpi=600 figure (L44-L45), plots row-1 slice surf[1,:] cyan (L46), axis [-0.5, Lt, min(depth[1,:])-.05, 1] (L47), bold labels (L49-L50), cyan water fill_between where surf>depth (L54-L56), dark-grey hatched bottom fill (L59-L61), a '~|' wavemaker annotation at x=WaveMaker (L64-L65), a time annotation 'Time: %4.2f sec' with i*plotInt-plotInt (L66-L67), and saves plots/surf_{0:05d}.png (L69-L71), closing the figure (L72).

equations.ref: comment L16: Change Depth to (-) under MWL and (+) over MWL

verbatim_spans.text: depth = (np.loadtxt('../work_solitary/depth_levee.txt'))*-1  # Change Depth to (-) under MWL and (+) over MWL.
[Nglob,Mglob]  = depth.shape   # recall that Fotran/FUNWAVE and C/C++/Matlab/Python are reversed!
assert num in range(1,numOfETA+1), "File Index:%d is not in range of station numbers." %(num,)

unresolved: bottom-fill condition where=depth[1,:]>(depth[1,:]-.05) (L60) is always true, so the where clause is a no-op
time annotation is placed at xy=(Lt*.85,3) (L66) while the y-axis is clipped at 1 by plt.axis (L47), so the text anchor lies outside the visible axes
readETAData takes a postprocessDir argument (L25) but uses the global outputDir (L33); the passed argument is ignored
plt.savefig keyword ext="png" (L71) is not a standard matplotlib argument
row index 1 (surf[1,:], depth[1,:]) selects the second row consistent with the MATLAB sibling's dep(2,:) artificial-row stripping, per comment L17
